atoms.a: Which of these do you think tourism has a direct impact on?

feedback.finish: Tourism can have both positive and negative effects on these things.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: One positive of tourism is that it generates trillions of dollars each year. On holiday, tourists spend money on accommodation, shopping, food and other activities.
Some countries heavily rely on tourism. The Maldives, an island country in South Asia, gets 68% of its income from tourism.
This money can be reinvested into the country to improve social services and infrastructure, such as roads, schools and public transport.

b: Tourists go swimming when on holiday.
The government invests more money into schools.

atoms.a: Which country relies heavily on tourism?
What might a country spend money from tourism on?

atoms.b: Unfortunately, tourism has many negative effects on the ((WiFi_connection ++environment)). For example, tourists often travel by plane, which ((drinks ++pollutes)) the air.
New infrastructure built for tourists, such as roads and accommodation, can also ((++damage conserve)) fragile ecosystems, such as coastlines or rainforests.

instruction.text: Select the three ways that tourism can positively affect people.

hint.text: Around the world, over 100 million people are employed in different jobs relating to tourism.
hint.label: Did you know?

sound: new jobs are created for locals

instruction.text: Read how tourism can also negatively affect people and select the matching image.

atoms.a: Popular destinations can become overcrowded and congested.
Tensions can arise between tourists and locals as tourists take over and change the area.
Historic sites can be worn down and damaged by tourists.

instruction.text: Are these effects of tourism positive or negative?

atoms.b: jobs are created for local people

feedback.finish: While tourism can bring a lot of money and opportunities to an area, it is also important to remember how local people, historic sites and the environment can be negatively impacted.
